merge_rule: No reroll. Merge the already adjudicated local result only as the global clock reaches each day.

chronology.Eniwetok_Island: Organized resistance ends center 19:20 (band 16:30..24 Feb 02:00); only fragmented infiltration remains.
chronology.Parry: 22d Marines reorganize/reembark while saturation preparation begins.
chronology.armor: Second group of three Type 95 becomes irrecoverable; six of nine named Eniwetok tanks now lost.

chronology.Parry: Naval/field-artillery/carrier preparation intensifies; fixed guns/C2 increasingly suppressed while small covered positions survive.
chronology.Engebi_base: Emergency recovery/liaison activity begins; not yet regular multi-squadron operation.

chronology.Parry: Assault H-hour 09:00. Three Type 95 counterattack 09:45..10:30 and are destroyed. One danger-close friendly-fire episode causes bounded US casualties and light/moderate LCI damage. Organized resistance ends center 21:40.
chronology.armor: All nine named Type 95 at Engebi/Eniwetok/Parry are now irrecoverable and fully posted out of the local/national residual.

chronology.Parry: Night remnants are cleared center 07:00; atoll secure declaration center 10:00.
chronology.security: Outer-islet/lagoon cleanup continues; lagoon logistics usable in assault sense but not a mature fleet base.
Outer-islet and lagoon security cleanup reaches logistics closeout.
chronology.Engebi_base: Limited fighter/search staging may begin within 27 Feb..1 Mar band; this is not yet regular multi-squadron base capability.
chronology.Eniwetok_strip: Bomber-strip construction remains an engineering project; no immediate bomber-base credit.

future_guard: Base-development dates after 27 Feb remain future; do not grant mid-March bomber-strip capability early.
